email.subject: AI for Bennett, Bricklin & Saltzburg, built for your insurance coverage practice
email.body:
Hi Theresa,

Bennett, Bricklin & Saltzburg has built something rare: a 53-attorney firm that's maintained deep client relationships for 40, 50, and 60+ years while handling complex insurance coverage and bad faith litigation. That loyalty speaks to your operational excellence.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Philadelphia office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete without losing the efficiency edge.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
